title: Unpaid Dues on Linden Memberships: Past Due, Reinstatement and Termination for Non-Payment
content:
Dues of Linden Memberships left unpaid the tier's payment grace days after their due date make the membership past due, and member services are suspended.

## Policy

1. **Past due.** When dues remain unpaid the tier's payment grace days after their due date, an active membership becomes past due. The record shows the date it became past due, which is the day after the grace days ended. Member services are suspended while the membership is past due.
2. **Reinstatement.** Paying all overdue dues plus the tier's reinstatement fee returns the membership to active, and the past-due date is cleared from the record.
3. **Termination for non-payment.** A membership still past due the tier's termination period of days after the date it became past due is terminated for non-payment. The unpaid dues stay on the Patient Financial Account, and re-enrollment waits the tier's rejoin waiting period in months. Any member visit credits remaining expire on termination, and the membership closes with termination for non-payment as the reason.
4. **When a termination may be recorded.** A termination is recorded only after the tier's termination period has passed since the date the membership became past due. The termination period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the date the membership became past due, and termination may be recorded only from the day after the last counted day.

The date the membership became past due is read from the membership record.

## Counting the termination period (hypothetical dates and periods)

| Became past due on | Termination period | Day 1 | Last counted day | Termination may be recorded from |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 30 days | 2 March | 31 March | 1 April |
| 10 June | 45 days | 11 June | 25 July | 26 July |
| 1 October | 60 days | 2 October | 30 November | 1 December |

In the first row, a termination is not recorded on 31 March, the last counted day; the earliest day is 1 April.

## Status at a glance

| Situation on the record | Result under this policy |
|---|---|
| Active, dues unpaid past the grace days | Becomes past due; member services suspended |
| Past due, all overdue dues and the reinstatement fee paid | Returns to active |
| Past due through the whole termination period, recorded on or after the day following the last counted day | Terminated for non-payment; unpaid dues remain on the Patient Financial Account |
| Past due, termination period not yet fully passed | Not terminated |
